title: HA WebSocket subscription <ns>/family/subscribe
description: Subscribes the calling HA user's paired device to the family pushes the hub sends for it with family_relay (ws/integration/family_relay.json). Answer: HA result {success: true, result: null}; then one HA event message {id, type: event, event} per push, event = ha-ws-family.event.json. Unsubscribe with the HA command unsubscribe_events {subscription: id} or by closing the socket. Same user checks as <ns>/family.
